properties.disease overview:
Traumatic loss of normal congruency between femoral head and acetabulum. Most commonly posterior dislocation; presents with characteristic limb position and severe pain with loss of function.

分类：posterior（最常见）、anterior、central（常伴髋臼骨折/中心移位）。
properties.mechanism: Usually high-energy trauma. Posterior dislocation typically occurs with axial load through a flexed hip (e.g., dashboard injury), resulting in femoral head displacement posteriorly; anterior dislocation occurs with forced abduction/external rotation; central dislocation involves acetabular fracture with medial displacement.
